faqs.question: What is an ATS?
faqs.answer: ATS (Applicant Tracking System) is software used by companies to screen resumes. It scans for keywords and filters candidates before human review.

faqs.question: How does ResumeTailor work?
faqs.answer: Upload your resume, paste the job description, and our AI analyzes both to optimize your resume with relevant keywords and formatting.

faqs.question: Is my data secure?
faqs.answer: Yes! Your data is encrypted and automatically deleted after 7 days. We never share or sell your information.

faqs.question: What formats are supported?
faqs.answer: We support PDF, DOCX, and TXT files for upload. You can download your tailored resume in PDF or DOCX format.

faqs.question: Are the templates really ATS-friendly?
faqs.answer: Yes! All our templates are designed specifically to be parsed correctly by major ATS systems while still looking professional.

faqs.question: Can I customize the templates?
faqs.answer: Absolutely! You can customize colors, fonts, and layout after selecting your template.
